title: The Peephole
hook: My new apartment came with one rule: the tape over the peephole stays on. Never look out after two in the morning... no matter who knocks.
lines: When I moved into apartment 4C, there was a strip of black tape over the peephole.
The super told me it stays there. Never peel it off. And never look out after two in the morning... no matter who knocks.
I thought he was joking. He wasn't smiling.
The first knock came on a Tuesday. Two-oh-one A.M.
Two soft taps... right at eye level.
Then a whisper through the crack of the door. It's okay... you can look.
It came back every night. Same time. Same taps. Same patient voice.
On the ninth night, I couldn't take it anymore. I peeled back the tape... and pressed my eye to the glass.
Nothing. Just a dark, blurry circle.
This morning I told the super. He unscrewed the peephole, turned it over in his hand... and went very quiet.
That tape was never there to stop me from looking out.
It was there to stop something from looking in.
